meta.name: ginkgo-cloud-lab
meta.description: Submit and manage protocols on Ginkgo Bioworks Cloud Lab (cloud.ginkgo.bio), a web-based interface for autonomous lab execution on Reconfigurable Automation Carts (RACs). Use when the user wants to run protein expression and purification (cell-free, E. coli, or Pichia), HiBiT or A280 or LabChip quantification, IVT mRNA/circRNA synthesis, thermal shift / developability assays, Echo-MS enzyme or analyte methods, SPR target onboarding, fluorescent pixel art, or otherwise interact with Ginkgo Cloud Lab services. Covers protocol selection, input preparation, pricing, and ordering workflows.

copy.tagline: 在 Ginkgo Cloud Lab 上提交和管理实验方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在云端自动化实验室运行生物实验流程。
copy.tagline_en: Submit and manage protocols on Ginkgo Cloud Lab
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to run automated lab experiments on a cloud platform.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会引导你在 Ginkgo Cloud Lab 上挑选蛋白质表达纯化、定量、RNA 合成等实验方案，准备输入模板，说明价格和周转时间，并跟进下单与报价流程。
howto.when: 当你想在 Ginkgo Cloud Lab 运行蛋白表达纯化、定量检测、RNA 合成等实验，或询问自定义方案价格时触发。

say.text: 帮我看看细胞-free 表达 HiBiT 方案的输入模板怎么填？
say.note: 会打开对应参考文件并说明模板要求。

say.text: IVT mRNA 合成多少钱，sample 数和周转几天？
用 EstiMate 评估一下我的自定义酶活检测方案可行性。
say.note: 引导到 EstiMate 提交描述。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude guides you through selecting protocols for protein expression/purification, quantification, RNA synthesis, etc., on Ginkgo Cloud Lab, helps prepare input templates, explains pricing and turnaround times, and walks through ordering and quote workflows.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to run protein expression/purification, quantification, RNA synthesis, or other experiments on Ginkgo Cloud Lab, or ask about custom protocol pricing.

say_en.text: How do I fill in the input template for the cell-free HiBiT expression protocol?
say_en.note: Opens the reference file and explains requirements.

say_en.text: How much does IVT mRNA synthesis cost, and what are the sample count and turnaround?
Use EstiMate to assess the feasibility of my custom enzyme activity assay.
say_en.note: Directs you to EstiMate to submit a description.
